allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Outcome of the Meeting of the Rights Issue Committee of Bonlon Industries Limited held today i.e. Wednesday, November 18, 2026

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Bonlon Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 18, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 1 : 1, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 1 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 30 per share.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Bonlon Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on the Rights Issue Committee Meeting scheduled to be held on Thursday, October 22, 2026 - Meeting Cancelled

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Bonlon Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of In-Principle Approval for Proposed Rights issue of Fully Paid-up Equity Share by the Company from BSE Limited and NSE Limited

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Bonlon Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''. Cancellation of the Meeting of the Rights Issue Committee of the company which was to be held on Thursday, August 20, 2026"
